title: Siegard material ledger
description: The frontmatter of `ledger.md` beside survey or intent material: where every fact line of the material went. «Every fact line of the material lands in a node or is left out with a stated reason» (SPEC-005 R8). One entry per fact line, keyed by the material file and the line's number; a line with no entry is a fact the analysis dropped, and `bin/trace.py --ledger` refuses the ledger. It is disclosure, not a second home: the fact lives in the node the entry names, and an entry names a node or a reason, never both. It sits beside the material, outside the specification root, so «Artifacts carry no provenance meta-fields» (SPEC-001 R8). `--stage --adopt --ledger` reads it to hand each file's judge the nodes its own facts landed in.

material.description: Every material file this ledger accounts for — survey material or intent material, each read against its own contract — by path relative to the ledger's own directory. A fact line of a file not listed here is unaccounted for.

at.description: The fact line: `<material file>:<line number>`, the file as `material` spells it.

node.description: The node whose fields hold this fact — «Identity is the node's path from the specification root, without `.md`» (SPEC-003 R1). Where one line's fact lands in several nodes, one entry per node.

outside.description: Why no node holds this fact: implementation knowledge, a fact another increment owns, a behavior the material observed and did not decide. One claim a reviewer can reject.
